mark_affecting.quote: threatening her with 'I'll be back'. But over at the Lyons' house, the very same policeman is completely deferential. He literally calls Mr Lyons 'sir'

flagged.title: Adolescence & Growing Apart
flagged.reason: The video states that Sammy escapes while Mickey is the one sentenced to prison, teaching an incorrect plot outcome for a key event in the play where Sammy is also arrested and sentenced to life.

mark_affecting.quote: Sammy escapes, and Mickey is the one sentenced to prison.

flagged.title: Structure, Music & the Narrator
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly presents 'That Guy' as a soliloquy sung only by Mickey rather than a duet between Mickey and Edward, misdescribing dramatic form which directly affects AO2 marks at GCSE.

mark_affecting.quote: The soliloquy... Think of the song 'That Guy'. Mickey sings this when he's watching Eddie... through this musical soliloquy, Russell lets us hear Mickey's deep frustration
